text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer! I did fine, I think.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Either way, next up is the Satsuki Sho.
We should
tailor my preparations
appropriately.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Training... Ah, but of course, you
would...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry about it, just talking to
myself.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Anyhow, time is money! Back to the lab!
Back to
the lab!
